findings.summary: Registration does not resolve the python interpreter at registration time (scripts/register_shopspend_task.ps1 does, because Task Scheduler PATH can differ from the interactive session). The cropster runner calls bare python (scripts/run_cropster.cmd:20), so a PATH mismatch would fail every Monday with exit 9009 instead of exit 2.
findings.suggestion: Before step 5 registers the task, verify it runs under Task Scheduler (e.g. Start-ScheduledTask once, then check logs/cropster.log for an exit line other than 9009). Optionally mirror the shopspend pattern: resolve Get-Command python at registration and pass the full path in the action arguments.

findings.summary: The LogPath printed in the -WhatIf summary is a second hard-coded copy of the log path that run_cropster.cmd owns (LOG=logs\cropster.log); the script never uses it for redirection.
findings.suggestion: Either drop the Log file line from the summary or add a comment that run_cropster.cmd is the source of truth, so the two literals cannot drift.
